newsTileInfo.title: Welcome to Just Dance Melody Online
newsTileInfo.text:
Grab your friends and family because It’s time to turn up the volume and let loose! 

[C:ff7b88e8]Just Dance Melody Online, [C:ff575757]the #1 Music Video Game streaming service of All Time is out this winter with 1500 songs and universes.

Join a community of more than 6000 players around the world and dance it out! 

[C:ff7b88e8]Just Dance Melody Online [C:ff575757]is a brand new platform for streaming and playing the latest & hottest songs the Just Dance Franchise has to offer! 

It features songs from previous mods such as Just Dance Asia!, as well as new additions exclusive to Just Dance Melody Online, 

So you'll have endless amounts of fun and songs to dance to! 

[C:ff7b88e8]Just Dance Melody Online is currently available for:

[C:ffe60012]Nintendo Switch Systems - Just Dance 2019 - 2020 - 2021 & 2022 

[C:ff2e6db4]PS4 - Just Dance 2019 - 2020 - 2021 & 2022 

[C:ff575757]PC - Just Dance 2017 

Thanks for Playing & Keep on dancing! - [C:ff7b88e8]JDMO Development Team [icon:star]

newsTileInfo.title: Join the Celebration!
newsTileInfo.text:
Hope you are hungry for cake, it's the 1 year anniversary of Just Dance Melody Online! 
To celebrate this special occassion we are releasing our greatly anticipated brand new world dance floor! 

Battle it out for your team in team battles, dance your heart out and defeat the boss, or prove you got what it takes in a tournament!

We hope you'll join us in celebrating this milestone with us!

Happy Dancing! - with love, [C:ff7b88e8] JDMO Team <3
